prompt:
Our biotech research workspace has become a mess — outdated notes scattered everywhere, files referenced by our scheduler that don't exist, and important summaries that should be front-and-center getting buried. We need a full nightly-style health check run on the workspace right now.

Please audit everything under /workspace, clean it up properly, and produce a report saved as audit-report.md at the root of the workspace. The report should tell us what was broken, what was cleaned up, what got reorganized, and the overall health of the workspace.
